text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for keeping me company.
I really wanted to go around doing big-city stuff!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So! Trainer, got any recommendations?
There're too many shops around, I can't really tell what's good.
choice_data_list: Umm, maybe some Hachimi to start with...?

text_block_list.text:
I said so, but frankly, I wasn't confident.
I really wanted to show her how to have fun in the city since she wasn't used to it, but—

Wait, Hachimukan!?
Then let's have it together, Seeeenpai!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Helios?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: After we grab some Hachimi together, let's do a "city-slicker fun" tour!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! Sounds great!
I'm counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaas expected, mega-sized is the only way to go!
Soft, rich, extra everything,
and a massive heap of whipped cream on ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It's huge?!
What kind of incantation is that order?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The topping options are practically endless, after all! If you're not sure, I'd recommend just asking for 'chef's choice with the popular stuff' for now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see...?
In that case, I'll go with the most popular choice...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sooo cute~~!! Ragi-senpai cuddling a plushie is peak gap moe, right!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh...!?
Not really sure what's going on, but thanks!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, doesn't this little one look kinda like Ace-san's dog?
You know, the one in the photo in her room!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, they do look kinda similar, don't they?
I wonder how she's doing~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Aayy! Check out this Insta-worthy spot~☆
Snapping pics in matching outfits is a guaranteed banger!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Insta-worthy... spot? What's that...?
Are we taking photos with this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup, Trainer, you join in too!
Here we go~, click!
And so, after being guided around everywhere and learning all sorts of "city fun"—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First off, let's festival it up! Put cho hands up~~!!
choice_data_list: (When did this turn into a full-blown festival!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fu~~!!
PakaâHypeâ Mix, c'mon!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Fu~~ wait, a stage right in the middle of town!?
That's awesome! Are we really allowed to just use this!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Okey-dokey! This spot's totally free!
So, can we get that shiny-shiny hype too?? Super hyped up??"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, let's totally hype it up! Should we sing?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~!!
Senpai's special performance is hereee!

text_block_list.name: Gals
text_block_list.text:
Look, Helios is festing again!
Lol, that's hilarious! Maybe we should join in.

More and more people began gathering around them.
In no time at all, the commotion grew massive—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Put your hands up... wait, whoaaaa!?
Why is a massive crowd gathering around us!?!?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Are y'all seriously that down to clown!?
Hahaha, oh god, that's killing me! Ahhahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, what's up, Ragi-ragi?!
Gyahaha, *cough*, you got me laughing too, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you two are cracking up way too much!
Perhaps finding the big-city sights utterly hilarious, Katsuragi Ace clutched her stomach in roaring laughter. She looked completely innocent and carefree.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Hahahaha, ah, my stomach hurts from laughing!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pounding, bustling, glittering.
My heart's thumping so hard, it feels like a festival rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So this is... the "big city"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad you enjoyed it.
—Though the city still has so much more depth to offer, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Well then, we gotta dive deep
and enjoy every last bit of it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Which means—... Traineeer!!
You come over here too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough if you're not here too!
Come on, hurry up and get up here!
choice_data_list: Well then... maybe I'll sing a little?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice~! Well then, the next song is—
"GIRLS' LEGEND U"!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

—And so, singing and dancing together, they thoroughly
enjoyed the "kind of fun you can only find in the big city."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, sounds great, sounds great!
Let's get hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: We're still makin' noise! Put your hands up!!

While I was singing, Katsuragi Ace
innocently cheered me on with her maracas.
